data.name: Montecito Coastline Dog Friendly Electric Bike and Sidecar Guided Tour
data.headline: Explore the Hidden Gems in Montecito & Santa Barbara!
data.description:
###Duration		
2.5  Hours

##About				
This electric bike tour is the perfect way to experience the beauty and charm of the Montecito and Santa Barbara areas. Whether you're a local looking to explore your own backyard, or a visitor looking to get a taste of California's stunning coastline, this tour is not to be missed!

Throughout the tour, our experienced guide will provide fascinating insights into the history and culture of the area, as well as tips on the best places to eat, shop, and explore. And with our easy-to-use electric bikes, you'll be able to cover a lot of ground without breaking a sweat.

meeting_point.address: 1801 E Cabrillo Blvd, Santa Barbara, CA 93108

data.cancellation_notes:
We will gladly refund any reservation that is cancelled in writing at least 7 days in advance of the reservation. For reservations that are cancelled within 7 days of the reservation, a store credit will be issued. We will not issue any refund or store credit for customers that don't show up or that call us to cancel after their reservation has started or on the day of the reservation. There is no refund on discounted reservations booked online or through third-party booking platforms.

We reserve the right to cancel any reservation due to poor weather or if we believe the rider is incapable of riding safely. If we cancel the reservation a full refund will be offered.
data.booking_notes:
Each rider can fill out this liability waiver ahead of time: https://flowcode.com/p/wR6hpZCMl

     Please plan to arrive 15 minutes before your tour time, even sooner with children, dogs, special needs, or a large party.

    Optional e-bike insurance ($15 per rider) is available up until your tour time to cover parts potentially damaged by the mishandling of the rider. 

     Monetary gestures of gratitude to your tour guide will be greatly appreciated.

    We recommend wearing layers, to include a wind/waterproof one, comfortable close-toed shoes and pants not too baggy at the ankles. Bring a water bottle to fill free here, or we may have bottled water available for purchase. Maybe bring a snack. 

     If you have any questions, feel free to call us directly at our Montecito shop at 805-837-0033.

###We look forward to riding with you!
